columns.name: id
columns.comment: 单次采集运行数值主键；BIGINT正整数，由12张业务表共享序列business_id_seq分配；API以十进制字符串返回，旧字符串ID通过迁移映射保留对应关系

columns.name: source_id
columns.comment: 来源ID，关联data_sources.id；历史运行引用时禁止直接删除来源；BIGINT数值外键，引用业务表数值主键，API使用十进制字符串

columns.name: parent_id
columns.comment: 失败父运行ID；与source_id复合自关联，仅retry填写，防止跨来源、自指和重复直接重试；BIGINT数值外键，引用业务表数值主键，API使用十进制字符串

columns.name: trigger_type
columns.comment: 触发类型：manual手动、schedule定时、retry失败重试；非retry的parent_id为空

columns.name: request_id
columns.comment: 全局唯一运行幂等键，varchar(128)；普通请求键原样保留；系统定时schedule:来源ID:计划触发UTC时刻按实际source_id映射，重试retry:父运行ID按实际parent_id映射，其余字节不变；映射后仍须全局唯一

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 采集状态：queued排队、running执行中、stopping正在停止、success成功、failed失败、cancelled取消

columns.name: available_at
columns.comment: 允许认领运行的最早时间；带时区，失败重试的退避截止时间也写入此字段

columns.name: config_snapshot
columns.comment: 本次采集配置JSON对象快照；重试沿用父记录配置，不回写后来修改的来源参数；明确的平台来源、类别等引用按实体映射，外部采集参数、普通请求键及执行令牌原样保留

columns.name: checkpoint
columns.comment: 已提交采集边界及受限失败标识的JSON对象；不保存材料正文，不跨过未处理失败项

columns.name: fetched_count
columns.comment: 本次已读取候选条目数；非负整数，不是请求次数或全库总量

columns.name: saved_count
columns.comment: 本次成功提交的新建或更新条目数；非负，与failed_count之和不超过fetched_count

columns.name: failed_count
columns.comment: 本次处理失败的候选条目数；非负，success状态必须为0，不重复累计父运行

columns.name: error
columns.comment: 执行失败或异常的脱敏简短原因；failed必须非空，success为空，不保存Cookie、密钥或堆栈

columns.name: stop_requested_at
columns.comment: 收到停止请求的带时区时间点；重复点击不重写，stopping或cancelled必须存在

columns.name: execution_token
columns.comment: 执行认领令牌；保存、心跳和结束回写须匹配，终态清空以隔离旧执行器；varchar(64)执行令牌，非数值主键，保留原业务字符串

columns.name: lease_expires_at
columns.comment: 当前执行租约截止时间；带时区，失联恢复前核对，终态清空

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: 实际开始采集的带时区时间点；排队即取消时可空

columns.name: finished_at
columns.comment: 确认成功、失败或取消的带时区时间点；stopping不得提前填写

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 运行记录创建时间，不晚于available_at；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 运行状态、计数或已提交断点最近更新时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

collection_runs.comment: 单次来源采集的排队、执行、停止及失败重试记录；保存独立计数和配置快照

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_active
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('running','stopping') OR (started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_active CHECK (status NOT IN ('running','stopping') OR (started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_counts
checks.expression: fetched_count >= 0 AND saved_count >= 0 AND failed_count >= 0 AND saved_count + failed_count <= fetched_count
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_counts CHECK (fetched_count >= 0 AND saved_count >= 0 AND failed_count >= 0 AND saved_count + failed_count <= fetched_count)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_error
checks.expression: status <> 'failed' OR (error IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(error)) > 0)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_error CHECK (status <> 'failed' OR (error IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(error)) > 0))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_json
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_json CHECK (jsonb_typeof(config_snapshot) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(checkpoint) = 'object')

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_lease_pair
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_lease_pair CHECK ((execution_token IS NULL) = (lease_expires_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_parent_id
checks.expression: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_parent_id CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_parent_trigger
checks.expression: (trigger_type = 'retry' AND parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR (trigger_type <> 'retry' AND parent_id IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_parent_trigger CHECK ((trigger_type = 'retry' AND parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR (trigger_type <> 'retry' AND parent_id IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_queued
checks.expression: status <> 'queued' OR (started_at IS NULL AND finished_at IS NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_queued CHECK (status <> 'queued' OR (started_at IS NULL AND finished_at IS NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_request_id
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_request_id CHECK (length(trim(request_id)) > 0)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_running
checks.expression: status <> 'running' OR (execution_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_running CHECK (status <> 'running' OR (execution_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_status
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_status CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','stopping','success','failed','cancelled'))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_stop
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('stopping','cancelled') OR stop_requested_at IS NOT NULL
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_stop CHECK (status NOT IN ('stopping','cancelled') OR stop_requested_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_success
checks.expression: status <> 'success' OR (failed_count = 0 AND error IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_success CHECK (status <> 'success' OR (failed_count = 0 AND error IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_terminal
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('success','failed','cancelled') OR (finished_at IS NOT NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_terminal CHECK (status NOT IN ('success','failed','cancelled') OR (finished_at IS NOT NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_times
checks.expression: (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') <= available_at AND (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND (started_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)) AND (stop_requested_at IS NULL OR stop_requested_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_times CHECK ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') <= available_at AND (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')) AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND (started_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)) AND (stop_requested_at IS NULL OR stop_requested_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_trigger_type
checks.ddl: ALTER TABLE collection_runs ADD CONSTRAINT ck_collection_runs_trigger_type CHECK (trigger_type IN ('manual','schedule','retry'))

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_lease
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_lease ON collection_runs (lease_expires_at) WHERE status IN ('running','stopping')

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_source_id
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_source_id ON collection_runs (source_id, created_at DESC, id)

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_status
indexes.ddl: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_status ON collection_runs (status, available_at)

indexes.name: uk_collection_runs_active
indexes.ddl: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_collection_runs_active ON collection_runs (source_id) WHERE status IN ('queued','running','stopping')

indexes.name: uk_collection_runs_parent_id
indexes.ddl: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_collection_runs_parent_id ON collection_runs (parent_id) WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL

columns.comment: 本次采集配置JSON对象快照；重试沿用父记录配置，不回写后来修改的来源参数；明确的平台来源、类别等引用按实体映射，外部采集参数、普通请求键及执行令牌原样保留

columns.name: checkpoint
columns.comment: 已提交采集边界及受限失败标识的JSON对象；不保存材料正文，不跨过未处理失败项

columns.name: fetched_count
columns.comment: 本次已读取候选条目数；非负整数，不是请求次数或全库总量

columns.name: saved_count
columns.comment: 本次成功提交的新建或更新条目数；非负，与failed_count之和不超过fetched_count

columns.name: failed_count
columns.comment: 本次处理失败的候选条目数；非负，success状态必须为0，不重复累计父运行

columns.name: error
columns.comment: 执行失败或异常的脱敏简短原因；failed必须非空，success为空，不保存Cookie、密钥或堆栈

columns.name: stop_requested_at
columns.comment: 收到停止请求的带时区时间点；重复点击不重写，stopping或cancelled必须存在

columns.name: execution_token
columns.comment: 执行认领令牌；保存、心跳和结束回写须匹配，终态清空以隔离旧执行器；varchar(64)执行令牌，非数值主键，保留原业务字符串

columns.name: lease_expires_at
columns.comment: 当前执行租约截止时间；带时区，失联恢复前核对，终态清空

columns.name: started_at
columns.comment: 实际开始采集的带时区时间点；排队即取消时可空

columns.name: finished_at
columns.comment: 确认成功、失败或取消的带时区时间点；stopping不得提前填写

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 运行记录创建时间，不晚于available_at；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 运行状态、计数或已提交断点最近更新时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_active
checks.definition: CHECK ((status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['running'::character varying::text, 'stopping'::character varying::text])) OR started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_counts
checks.definition: CHECK (fetched_count >= 0 AND saved_count >= 0 AND failed_count >= 0 AND (saved_count + failed_count) <= fetched_count)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_error
checks.definition: CHECK (status::text <> 'failed'::text OR error IS NOT NULL AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM error)) > 0)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_parent_id
checks.definition: CHECK (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_parent_trigger
checks.definition: CHECK (trigger_type::text = 'retry'::text AND parent_id IS NOT NULL OR trigger_type::text <> 'retry'::text AND parent_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_queued
checks.definition: CHECK (status::text <> 'queued'::text OR started_at IS NULL AND finished_at IS NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_running
checks.definition: CHECK (status::text <> 'running'::text OR execution_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND stop_requested_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_status
checks.definition: CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::character varying::text, 'running'::character varying::text, 'stopping'::character varying::text, 'success'::character varying::text, 'failed'::character varying::text, 'cancelled'::character varying::text]))

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_stop
checks.definition: CHECK ((status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['stopping'::character varying::text, 'cancelled'::character varying::text])) OR stop_requested_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_success
checks.definition: CHECK (status::text <> 'success'::text OR failed_count = 0 AND error IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_terminal
checks.definition: CHECK ((status::text <> ALL (ARRAY['success'::character varying::text, 'failed'::character varying::text, 'cancelled'::character varying::text])) OR finished_at IS NOT NULL AND execution_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_collection_runs_times
checks.definition: CHECK ((created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text) <= available_at AND (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)) AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text) AND (started_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)) AND (stop_requested_at IS NULL OR stop_requested_at >= (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)))

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_lease
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_lease ON public.collection_runs USING btree (lease_expires_at) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('running'::character varying)::text, ('stopping'::character varying)::text]))

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_source_id
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_source_id ON public.collection_runs USING btree (source_id, created_at DESC, id)

indexes.name: idx_collection_runs_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_collection_runs_status ON public.collection_runs USING btree (status, available_at)

indexes.name: uk_collection_runs_active
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_collection_runs_active ON public.collection_runs USING btree (source_id) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('queued'::character varying)::text, ('running'::character varying)::text, ('stopping'::character varying)::text]))

indexes.name: uk_collection_runs_parent_id
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_collection_runs_parent_id ON public.collection_runs USING btree (parent_id) WHERE (parent_id IS NOT NULL)

collection_runs.comment: 单次来源采集的排队、执行、停止及失败重试记录；保存独立计数和配置快照

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 采集来源数值主键；BIGINT正整数，由12张业务表共享序列business_id_seq分配；API以十进制字符串返回，旧字符串ID通过迁移映射保留对应关系

columns.name: name
columns.comment: 真实网站、公众号或论文库名称；必填，不虚构采集来源

columns.name: type
columns.comment: 来源类型：website新闻网站、wechat公众号、paper论文库

columns.name: url
columns.comment: 真实来源入口或历史文章来源地址；可空，不自动把推测主页当采集入口

columns.name: adapter
columns.comment: 受控采集器注册标识；不是任意命令或可执行代码，启用前核对实现

columns.name: cron
columns.comment: 来源定时采集表达式；为空仅允许手动触发，不在config重复保存周期

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: 采集计划IANA时区名；默认Asia/Shanghai，决定cron的当地时间语义

columns.name: next_run_at
columns.comment: 下次采集调度时间点，带时区；仅is_enabled=true且cron非空时非空

columns.name: config
columns.comment: 采集参数JSON对象；保存分页、限速、超时、增量及重试策略，凭证仅存引用

columns.name: model_id
columns.comment: 自动翻译模型ID，关联ai_models.id；为空不自动翻译，不静默换用其他模型

columns.name: is_enabled
columns.comment: 来源入队及启动开关；true启用、false停用，停用不等于当前运行已停止

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 来源建档时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 来源名称、采集配置或开关最近修改时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

checks.name: ck_data_sources_cron
checks.definition: CHECK (cron IS NULL OR length(TRIM(BOTH FROM cron)) > 0)

checks.name: ck_data_sources_cursor
checks.definition: CHECK (is_enabled AND cron IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL OR (NOT is_enabled OR cron IS NULL) AND next_run_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_data_sources_names
checks.definition: CHECK (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM adapter)) > 0)

indexes.name: idx_data_sources_next_run_at
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_data_sources_next_run_at ON public.data_sources USING btree (next_run_at) WHERE (is_enabled AND (cron IS NOT NULL))

data_sources.comment: 新闻网站、公众号与论文来源及采集配置；来源开关与单次采集状态分别维护

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 周期简报计划数值主键；BIGINT正整数，由12张业务表共享序列business_id_seq分配；API以十进制字符串返回，旧字符串ID通过迁移映射保留对应关系

columns.name: user_id
columns.comment: 计划所有者ID，关联sys_user.id；周期生成的成果必须属于同一用户

columns.name: name
columns.comment: 用户维护的周期计划名称；用于计划选择和管理

columns.name: template_id
columns.comment: 简报模板ID，关联templates.id；必填且模板purpose必须为digest；BIGINT数值外键，引用业务表数值主键，API使用十进制字符串

columns.name: frequency
columns.comment: 生成周期：daily每日、weekly每周、monthly每月

columns.name: weekday
columns.comment: 每周执行星期；0周一至6周日，仅weekly填写，其他周期为空

columns.name: month_day
columns.comment: 每月执行日；1至31，仅monthly填写，短月按当月末日执行

columns.name: run_time
columns.comment: 当地固定执行时分秒；与timezone共同解释，不是某天的绝对时间点

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: 计划采用的IANA时区名；默认Asia/Shanghai，用于当地时间转UTC调度

columns.name: selection_config
columns.comment: 选材条件JSON对象；包含日期窗口、类别、来源、关键词、去重及最多50篇的自动选材策略；显式类别、来源及资料ID或ID数组按实体映射为十进制字符串，关键词和日期窗口原样保留

columns.name: generation_config
columns.comment: 生成设置JSON对象；保存摘要长度和配图等参数，不重复整段材料正文；显式平台业务引用按实体映射，供应商模型标识、提示词及普通参数原样保留

columns.name: is_enabled
columns.comment: 计划开关；true启用、false停用，启用前校验真实文本模型及资料条件

columns.name: next_run_at
columns.comment: 下次触发的带时区时间点；启用时必填，原子认领后推进调度游标

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: 周期计划创建时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 周期计划配置或调度游标最近更新时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai本地墙钟，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒；API/页面格式YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

columns.name: last_run_at
columns.comment: 最近派发检查时间；北京时间Asia/Shanghai，timestamp(0)无时区，精度到秒，YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss；历史为空不回填

columns.name: last_status
columns.comment: 最近派发结果：queued入队、no_data无匹配、skipped节假日跳过、failed失败；历史为空；生成进度读取关联任务

columns.name: last_error
columns.comment: 最近派发失败原因，脱敏后保存；成功或跳过时清空，不包含模型密钥或内部堆栈

checks.name: ck_digest_schedules_frequency
checks.definition: CHECK (frequency::text = 'daily'::text AND weekday IS NULL AND month_day IS NULL OR frequency::text = 'weekly'::text AND weekday IS NOT NULL AND weekday >= 0 AND weekday <= 6 AND month_day IS NULL OR frequency::text = 'monthly'::text AND month_day IS NOT NULL AND month_day >= 1 AND month_day <= 31 AND weekday IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_digest_schedules_last_status
checks.definition: CHECK (last_status IS NULL OR (last_status::text = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::character varying, 'no_data'::character varying, 'skipped'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying]::text[])))

checks.name: ck_digest_schedules_next_run_at
checks.definition: CHECK (NOT is_enabled OR next_run_at IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_digest_schedules_next_run_at

columns.name: id

columns.name: report_id
columns.comment: 成果ID，关联reports.id；所有者从成果取得，不重复保存user_id；BIGINT数值外键，引用业务表数值主键，API使用十进制字符串

columns.name: schedule_id
columns.comment: 周期计划ID，关联digest_schedules.id；手动任务为空，计划删除受限；BIGINT数值外键，引用业务表数值主键，API使用十进制字符串

columns.name: request_id
columns.comment: 全局唯一幂等键，varchar(128)；普通客户端键及manual:随机UUID原样保留；系统schedule:计划ID:触发UTC时刻仅按实际schedule_id映射内嵌计划ID，UTC后缀不变，映射后仍须全局唯一

columns.name: status
columns.comment: 执行状态：queued排队、running执行中、completed完成、failed失败、cancelled取消

columns.name: progress
columns.comment: 任务进度百分比；整数0至100，默认0

columns.name: config_snapshot
columns.comment: 任务配置JSON对象快照；保存模板、提示词、模型标识、参数及成果起始版本，不含密钥或重复材料正文；显式平台业务引用按实体映射为十进制字符串，普通参数和提示词不改写；request_fingerprint须由映射后的request及materials按应用规范重新计算核验

columns.name: materials

columns.name: result_content

columns.name: error

columns.name: attempts

columns.name: lease_expires_at

columns.name: execution_token

columns.name: updated_at
